hard_constraints: Single POV: Ben Skywalker throughout; no head-hopping or ensemble perspectives.
No in-universe references to publishing terms like 'Legends' or 'Canon'.
Use Star Wars Legends terminology and avoid anachronisms (e.g., datapad, not laptop; comlink, not radio).
Do not turn the scene into a history lesson on Veraine, Sith alchemy, or Brotherhood of Darkness; limit to what's revealed in monitoring file per scene beats.

Force descriptions: Experiential and mystical per Legends (no 'energy field'); use Ben's sensory vocabulary (handrail/footing gone, etc.) without diagnostic terms like 'Weave' (not introduced until Ch9).
'Jedi' singular/plural identical; 'Darth' capitalized only before name.
canon_risks: Risk of inflating Veraine's profile with unprompted Legends Brotherhood details (e.g., Kaan's thought bomb) beyond AU seed (alchemist/strategist, captured anchor).
Kael's reaction must seed AU parallel (shared anchor history) without implying non-AU Sith conscript lore.
Sera's silence on Veraine's capabilities: Risk of accidental exposition violating 'her knowledge obvious and unoffered' beat.
legends_continuity_notes: Brotherhood of Darkness (EU canon): Sith coalition ~1010-1000 BBY led by Lord Kaan; emphasized equality among Lords over traditional Sith hierarchy; ended at Ruusan via thought bomb. Specializations like alchemy/strategy plausible per era (e.g., Sith sorcery in Darth Bane novels).
Sith alchemy (Legends): Arcane dark side arts for transmutation, creature creation (e.g., Naga Sadow's beasts, Sharad Hett's Tusken sorcery); not Disney 'kyber bleeding'; fits Veraine's AU profile.
Darth title (Brotherhood era): Used selectively alongside 'Lord'; Kaan preferred 'Lord'; Veraine's 'Darth Veraine' aligns with AU as individual Sith identity.
Post-Fate of the Jedi (47 ABY): Jedi Order under Luke on Coruscant; Galactic Alliance government; no Legacy comics future (out of scope).
